# Find the stadium with the maximum capacity
max_capacity = df['Capacity'].max()
# Filter rows where Capacity equals the maximum capacity
max_capacity_rows = df[df['Capacity'] == max_capacity]
# Extract the stadium name(s) - there could be multiple if ties exist
stadiums_with_max_capacity = max_capacity_rows['Stadium'].tolist()
# If only one stadium has the maximum capacity, return it as a scalar
if len(stadiums_with_max_capacity) == 1:
    answer = stadiums_with_max_capacity[0]
else:
    answer = stadiums_with_max_capacity
